transcript: Every morning, an old fisherman pushed his small boat into the sea before sunrise. The waves were cold and the nets were heavy. One stormy day he came back with nothing. But the next morning, he went out again. That is how he taught his grandson that patience is a kind of courage.

(3) Global assignment takes the highest (scene, clip) pairs first, each clip used once, if score >= tau=0.24. (4) If a scene's best stock score < tau+0.03 and AI is allowed, an AI image is generated and wins only if its CLIP score >= stock + 0.02. (5) Otherwise the best unused clip within 0.03 of tau, else a text card.
